blocks.text: The most important and common effects of air pollutants are the formation of smog (14.6.1) and acid rain (14.6.2).

blocks.prompt: Which pollutants are behind both smog and acid rain?
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen oxides from combustion appear in both: in sunlight with VOCs they make photochemical smog, and dissolved in moisture they give nitric and nitrous acids. Sulfur dioxide drives classical smog and, oxidised to sulfuric acid, most acid rain.

items: Chief effects of air pollutants: smog and acid rain.
